notes: Hand-authored preview-only bundle: SvelteKit prerenders one @dsCard HTML per card from the real components (see scripts/build-design-system.mjs). Not the React esbuild converter path — no local _ds_bundle.js/_ds_sync.json is produced (the app compiles its own _ds_bundle.js/_ds_manifest.json from the @dsCard markers when _ds_needs_recompile is written); every sync re-uploads all cards + README (card count lives in design-system/README.md).
